findings.description: The prompt requests a preference about the neighborhood, while the model expresses a preference for the flat because of its location. It is unclear whether that indirect location preference is intended to satisfy the neighborhood requirement. The generic rubric does not resolve this scope question.
findings.suggestion: Clarify whether describing the flat's location counts. If a neighborhood preference is required, make the model explicit, for example: "Me gusta vivir aquí porque hay un café cerca de mi piso." Otherwise, broaden the prompt to permit describing the flat or its surroundings.
